collection.title: Audi RS4 Avant 2006 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi RS4 Avant 2006 to 2008 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Slider arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this model too.
